info.name: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform Add-Ons Systems API

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of results to skip before returning.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field to sort results by. Prefix with a dash for descending order.

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of RHEL systems registered with Red Hat Insights, including their stale status and last check-in time.

params.name: system_id
params.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the system.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of a specific registered system, including its display name, last check-in time, and total number of active recommendations.
